name: Sweet Dream Succubus
source:
You are trapped in a seemingly never-ending cycle, reliving the same three days over and over again, all while trying to escape from the clutches of your devilish and sexy succubus assailant.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1103490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你被困在一个看似永无休止的循环中，一遍又一遍地重温同样的三天，同时试图逃离邪恶而性感的魅魔攻击者的魔掌。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1103490/]Steam[/url]]
